transcript: Before the first count of days God brought heaven and earth into being Earth stood bare, unfinished Blackness covered the deep Across the water moved the spirit of God Then God called, light come forth Brightness answered Hey He looked on the light Good He cut a clear line between it and darkness day Was the name he gave the light Night the name he gave the darkness Dawn the first day God spoke A firmament amid the water Let water, apart from water His word took hold He raised that mighty span, flood beneath it Flood the buffet, He called the form of heaven He looked on it, good dust on the second day Hey, water's below heaven Run to one place Let dry ground show The waters gathered land came clear He named the dry ground earth the gathered waters seas He looked on them Grounds and up seed bearing grass and kind and likeness Trees bare fruit with seed within each true to its kind His words are called Grease surge from the soil grass With seed in its kind of likeness Fruit wrapped around its seed Tree by tree, kind by kind He looked on it On it On it Dusk dawn the third day Lights across heaven's firmament Divide day from night Mark's signs, seasons, days and years From that high Shine on the earth, His way Took home To great light, seed fashion The greater to command the day The lesser to command the night He made the stars as well He set them in heaven's span To send their light across the earth to rule night and day to keep the bride apart from the dark He looked on them Good Dusked on the fourth day Water sworn with living reptiles Wind creatures fly above the earth Across Heaven Firmament His Word took hold God made the great whales Every living water reptile by kind And every winged creature by kind He looked on them, good His blessing rang out Increase, multiply, fill the seas Let the winged multiply on earth Dust on the fifth day Ever bring out living kinds Four-footed beasts calling reptiles While beasts eat after its kind His words look whole He fashioned wild beasts Kettle and the reptiles of the ground Eat after its kind He looked on them good Then God said, let us make humankind In our image, in our likeness Let the wing and multiply on earth cost Best word took all A fashion wild beasts' kettle And the reptiles of the ground Each after sky He looked on them all good Then God said, let us make humankind in our image, in our likeness Let them rule the fish, the birds, the cattle, all the earth and all that cross Hey, dust on the fish, hey Mmm, mmm, mmm, mmm, good you
